cards.hint: Think about weight and size effects in a vacuum.
cards.quote: In a vacuum, a beach ball falls with the same acceleration as an airliner.
cards.stem: In a vacuum, how does the fall of a beach ball compare to an airliner

cards.hint: Recall the sentence about describing a free fall.
cards.quote: The weight, size, and shape of the object are not a factor in describing a free fall.
cards.stem: Which object features do not affect describing a free fall

cards.hint: Look for the force expressed as weight.
cards.quote: An object that falls through a vacuum is subjected to only one external force, the gravitational force, expressed as the weight of the object.
cards.stem: What single external force acts on an object falling through a vacuum

cards.hint: Check the constant mentioned for sea level.
cards.quote: The acceleration is constant and equal to the gravitational acceleration g which is 9.8 meters per square second at sea level on the Earth.
cards.stem: What is the value of free fall acceleration at sea level on Earth
